content: LlamaIndex callbacks split text splitting from the model call. CBEventType.CHUNKING start payload is the original text and the end payload is the resulting chunks. CBEventType.LLM carries the prompt or messages on start and the completion or response on end. LlamaDebugHandler stores those event pairs for inspection. Chunking and LLM are separate events. Source: https://developers.llamaindex.ai/python/framework-api-reference/callbacks/ and the sentence splitter in llama-index-core.
